summary: Los Angeles is a sprawling metropolis where entertainment, culture, and natural beauty converge. From iconic beaches and Hollywood glamour to world-class museums and diverse culinary scenes, LA offers endless exploration for every traveler. The year-round sunshine and stunning coastal views make it a perennial favorite destination.

lensRecommendations: 24-70mm for versatile urban and landscape photography capturing diverse compositions
50mm prime for street photography and portrait work with shallow depth of field
16-35mm ultra-wide for expansive cityscape and dramatic landscape views
70-200mm telephoto for compressed distant views and wildlife along coastlines
photography.goldenHourNotes: Los Angeles experiences magical golden hour lighting from approximately 7:00-8:30am and 4:30-7:00pm depending on season. The clear air and elevated vantage points like Griffith Observatory and Getty Center offer particularly stunning warm-toned light. Smog pollution can be heavier in afternoon hours, making early morning shoots preferable for maximum clarity and color saturation.

weather.seasonality: Los Angeles enjoys a Mediterranean climate with mild, wet winters and warm, dry summers. The best time to visit is spring (April-May) and fall (September-October) when temperatures are comfortable and rainfall is minimal.
weather.summary: Los Angeles offers nearly year-round sunshine with average temperatures ranging from 13°C in winter to 25°C in summer. Rainfall primarily occurs between November and March, while summer months are virtually rain-free and ideal for outdoor activities.
